PARTNER WITH US
The future is yours to create
AI transformation for leaders
Who shape their industries.
Start the Conversation
AI transformation
delivered end-to-end,
with one team.

Most firms sell strategy. Some sell adoption. A few sell engineering. Creative Glu is the team built to deliver all three: simultaneously, seamlessly, and in sync. We embed pods within your team, extract the expertise that makes you a Titan, and build the AI-native infrastructure that multiplies it.

STRATEGY
Clarify the blueprint for your next era.
You don't need more noise. You need clarity: the kind that comes from a fractional Chief AI Officer who understands your market, your moat, and the one idea you could see. We define your AI roadmap, align your leadership, and identify the opportunities that actually move the needle.
ADOPTION
Equip your people to thrive in an AI-powered organization.
AI only works when humans do. Our adoption approach redesigns workflows, trains teams, and builds the cultural muscle memory needed to absorb AI systems at scale. We make sure the organization doesn't just understand the change, it embodies it.
ENGINEERING
Build the system that amplifies your genius.
Anyone can build a prototype. We build production-grade, agentic AI systems that encode your expertise, transforming it into a repeatable, scalable engine. This is where your vision becomes a living, evolving asset.

Don't start from scratch.

Stand on the
shoulders of giants.

You don't need to invent AI systems from zero. We've already done the hard part.

Our solutions are built from repeated, real-world deployments across industries. That pattern recognition lets organizations, like yours, start at roughly 80% with proven architectures, workflows, and intelligence systems ready to deploy. Instead of spending years figuring out what works, focus on the final 20%: refining your unique advantage.

The result is faster launches, lower risk, and AI systems that quickly deliver value

Accelerate Your Path To Market
Aligned with leaders
shaping what's next.

We collaborate with founders, operators, and creators shaping the next era of their industries. All share a common trait: ambition that outlives the moment.

The shift is already 
underway.

Why now? Agentic AI isn't a feature upgrade; it's an operating-model shift. The winners are embedding intelligence into every function, rebuilding workflows, and unlocking an estimated $4.4T in corporate productivity. This isn't speculative. Leaders are already moving.

At CreativeGlu, we don't debate if this shift is happening. We help leaders operationalize it: fast, responsibly, and at scale.

Explore AI Transformation

AI is an absolute necessity.

AI is going to change literally every job.

— Doug McMillon, CEO
Frequently Asked Questions
What is forward-deployed AI transformation?
Forward-deployed AI transformation embeds dedicated teams — strategy, adoption, and engineering pods — directly within your organization to operationalize AI across your business. Unlike traditional consulting that delivers recommendations and exits, forward-deployed pods stay through implementation, building production-grade systems and driving measurable adoption until the transformation is real.
How does the Creative Glu pod model work?
Creative Glu operates through three specialized pods — Strategy, Adoption, and Engineering — that function as embedded extensions of your team. Each pod runs on monthly sprint cycles with documented scope, delivery, and outcomes. Pods can be combined based on your needs and adjusted month-to-month as priorities evolve. Every dollar goes directly to AI expertise and execution.
What industries does Creative Glu work with?
Creative Glu collaborates with organizations across all industries including healthcare, financial services, private equity, legal, logistics, automotive, education, insurance, agriculture, and technology. Our cross-industry pattern recognition — built from working across multiple transformation stages simultaneously — accelerates time-to-value in ways no single internal team can replicate.
What is the difference between AI transformation and AI consulting?
AI consulting delivers strategy decks and recommendations, then moves on. AI transformation embeds with your team to execute — building production-grade systems, driving organizational adoption, and staying until measurable value is captured. Creative Glu's forward-deployed model bridges strategy and execution, operating with startup speed and enterprise-grade rigor.
How do you measure AI transformation success?
Success is measured through tangible business outcomes: revenue generated, costs reduced, time saved, adoption rates achieved, and AI maturity progression from Type 0 (Aware) through Type IV (AI Native). Every pod maintains a monthly performance ledger documenting commitments, deliverables, and measurable impact.
What is the Creative Glu AI Maturity Scale?
The Creative Glu AI Maturity Scale assesses organizations from Type 0 (Aware) through Type IV (AI Native). Type 0 means leadership sees AI in the news but hasn't acted. Type IV means your organization operates with full technical leverage in a fully AI-integrated paradigm. We drive transformation through each stage using embedded pods that combine strategy, adoption, and engineering.
Have more questions?

We're here to help you understand how forward-deployed AI transformation can work for your organization.

Start the Conversation

Let's redefine your industry.
